cases.case_label: Homozygous Alu insertion in RP1 exon 4
cases.mechanism_detail: A girl with early-onset RP carried a homozygous pathogenic RP1 Alu insertion in exon 4, missed by panel and exome pipelines and found by reduced coverage in IGV; effect inferred from location (functional consequence not studied in this report).
cases.quote: IGV review revealed a markedly reduced read coverage within exon 4 of RP1 in both datasets, suggesting the homozygous Alu insertion.
